method: Every encoded frame is reviewed in consecutive, function-matched reference/final pairs. Source cells are 384x216; the viewing tool resizes each 1536x2390 sheet to 1274x1984 (about 318x179 per cell). Selected actual encoded frames are separately inspected at 1920x1080. No percentage of visual identity is inferred.
